shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat upright slab
repeated small motifs in a row/band
justification: Both are low-relief slabs with profile creatures, a row of repeated small motifs and areas of hatched infill, but these are generic carving conventions rather than a shared motif set. A shows a stack of zoomorphic registers (quadrupeds, a duck-like bird, snakes/animals with no human protagonist) while B is dominated by a single large frontal-bodied winged anthropomorphic figure holding an object among stylised plant/rosette elements, so the specific subject matter, relationships and composition differ almost entirely.
